required_change: Freeze the first sidecar manifest to no-CPU slow, ordinary/utility fast, background/maintenance slow, fresh finite, stale finite, and one matched no-helper control.
first_validation: The sidecar dry run reproduces the known class ordering before any privileged collector is attached.
stop_condition: Stop if the manifest no longer separates the known fast and slow classes before counters are added.

source_surface: external CPU helper launch path used by task-end / CPU controls
required_change: Record helper pid, process group, command, nice/taskpolicy/QoS policy, launch/start/end timestamps, CPU duration, exit status, and stderr/stdout paths for each retained-key window.
first_validation: Every helper-backed retained key joins to exactly one helper lifetime and policy row; no-helper rows explicitly record no helper.
stop_condition: Stop if helper policy or lifetime can only be inferred from the run label.

required_change: Emit a stable window id with run id, delay, delay mode, sample index, retained/throwaway status, q50 inclusion, keydown/keypress/keyup enqueue times, EventDispatch start/end, and browser/host clock sync.
first_validation: 100% of retained q50-contributing keys have key-window fields and match existing latency records.
stop_condition: Stop before root collectors if retained-key joins are missing or alter q50 output.

source_surface: Playwright browser/process metadata; CDP target/session metadata
required_change: Record browser pid, renderer pid, main thread id if available, target id, frame id, browser revision, and page URL/document fixture metadata per run.
first_validation: Each retained key can be attributed to the foreground renderer that handled the input.
stop_condition: Stop if powermetrics/trace would describe only browser-wide or wrong-process counters.

source_surface: benchmark raw JSON and report extractor schema
required_change: Before root collection, add collector run id placeholders, intended powermetrics plist path, trace path, sample interval, notification labels, and observer configuration fields.
first_validation: Sidecar-only artifacts contain all join columns that later root collector files will fill.
stop_condition: Stop if adding collector fields forces an incompatible artifact schema or changes curated metrics.

source_surface: compact CPU/QoS manifest with collectors disabled
required_change: Run the compact manifest with the sidecar enabled and privileged collectors disabled.
first_validation: Class ordering survives, all retained windows join to helper and renderer fields, and sidecar overhead is bounded by matched no-sidecar rows.
stop_condition: Do not run root powermetrics if the sidecar alone perturbs the benchmark.

required_change: After the sidecar passes, collect 100ms plist samples with tasks, cpu_power, thermal, sfi, pstates, process QoS/tier/AMP/IPC/wait-time fields.
first_validation: One sampled OS state predicts ordinary/utility fast rows and finite decay while absent from no-CPU and background/maintenance slow rows.
stop_condition: Escalate to root trace if frequency/residency/QoS counters do not separate the rows or sampling misses key windows.

required_change: Only after powermetrics is insufficient, record scheduler/QoS trace rows with the same sidecar windows and notification labels.
first_validation: Runnable latency, processor selection, wakeup, or effective QoS explains the residual after matching powermetrics state.
stop_condition: Do not claim Darwin scheduler/QoS placement if trace overhead changes class ordering or counters still do not join per key.

source_surface: Chromium scheduler trace; lower-level renderer counters
required_change: Only after OS counters fail, add browser scheduler/task-queue traces or lower-level renderer counters joined to the same key windows.
first_validation: Browser queue/cache/stall state predicts residual latency after OS frequency, residency, and scheduler state are controlled.
stop_condition: Keep the mechanism unnamed if browser/cache rows need unrelated explanations or observer controls fail.
